summary: Defines FLUTE, a protocol for delivering files one-way over the Internet, especially suited to multicast networks. It builds on Asynchronous Layered Coding, the base protocol for massively scalable multicast distribution. It is an experimental protocol and was replaced by RFC 6726.

eli5.summary: A radio tower sends the same song to everyone listening without asking each person. FLUTE sends files this way, and listeners cannot talk back.
